title: A bill to amend title 38, United States Code, to clarify the grade and pay of podiatrists of the Department of Veterans Affairs.
official_summary: This bill states that the grade and pay of podiatrists of the Department of Veterans Affairs are on the same schedule as physicians and dentists.

summary.headline: A 2019 law sets the pay and grade of VA podiatrists to match the schedule used for VA physicians and dentists.
summary.what_it_does: This law amends title 38 of the U.S. Code, which governs veterans' affairs. It states that podiatrists who work for the Department of Veterans Affairs are placed on the same pay and grade schedule as VA physicians and dentists. The summary does not describe specific pay amounts or changes to individual salaries.

who_it_affects.group: Podiatrists employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs
who_it_affects.how: Their grade and pay are set on the same schedule used for VA physicians and dentists.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive foot and ankle care at VA facilities
who_it_affects.how: The law addresses how VA podiatrists are paid and graded, but the summary does not say it changes the care veterans receive.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on April 8, 2019, and the summary does not list a separate effective date.
